title: Minimum Number of Flips to Make the Binary String Alternating
goal: Minimize bit flips to make some cyclic rotation alternate.
strategy: Every length-n window of the doubled string represents a rotation. Maintain mismatch count against an alternating target; the complement target has n minus that count.
